method: Independent manual full-text reading; no app-generated output; original source retained.

quote_validation.method: Extract each Markdown blockquote; HTML-decode source pre text; collapse whitespace; assert each complete excerpt is a literal substring. No punctuation or hyphen normalization.

limitations: Pinned enrolled text only; enactment date, implementation and present law not independently established.
Referenced external statutory rules and amounts unresolved unless reproduced.
No specified monetary amount does not establish zero fiscal cost.
Negative findings require full-text review; no individual excerpt proves absence.
